Director Statistics // Strategic Leadership in R&D
Location: Netherlands (on-site)
Are you a strategic leader in statistics with a passion for driving scientific excellence and building high-performing teams? Do you thrive at the intersection of data, innovation, and leadership?
We are offering a unique opportunity for a Director Statistics to shape the future of data-driven research within an international, innovation-driven organization.
This role goes beyond leadership alone. It is designed for professionals who are ready to make impact today, while positioning themselves for a broader executive role in the coming years.
The opportunity
As
Director Statistics
, you will lead and develop a team of statisticians operating within a global R&D environment. You will play a critical role in ensuring scientific rigor, driving innovation in data methodologies, and influencing strategic decision-making across the organization.
You will operate at the heart of biometrics, health data, and advanced analytics, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex scientific questions into actionable insights.
Your impact
You will:
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing international team of statisticians
Define and elevate statistical strategy across research programs and study designs
Act as a senior subject matter expert in areas such as experimental design, data analysis, and interpretation
Drive innovation in modern methodologies including RWD/RWE, causal inference, and Bayesian approaches
Ensure compliance with global regulatory frameworks and quality standards
Influence senior stakeholders and translate complex data into clear business insights
Contribute to the long-term data and analytics vision of the organization
Leadership & growth trajectory
This position is intentionally positioned as a stepping stone toward broader executive leadership.
Within the next few years, you will have the opportunity to expand your scope beyond team leadership into areas such as:
Global data strategy ownership
Cross-functional R&D leadership
Enterprise-level decision-making and transformation programs
About you
You are an experienced leader with both technical depth and strategic vision.
MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related field
Proven experience leading statistical or biometrics teams
Strong expertise in study design, statistical methodologies, and regulatory environments
Experience working in complex, highly regulated environments like
pharma, medical food, biotech
is a critical requirement
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at senior level
Hands-on experience with tools such as R and/or SAS
Preferred:
Experience with real-world data, adaptive designs, or advanced modelling techniques
Exposure to digital health data or AI-driven analytics
Familiarity with modern data/engineering environments
Why this role?
Strategic leadership position with real impact on innovation and research quality
International, collaborative environment
Clear pathway toward executive-level responsibility
Opportunity to shape the future of data-driven decision making
Interested?
If you are ready to step into a Director role with both immediate impact and long-term career growth, we would love to connect.
